query: What does the 'Two-way traffic ahead' sign instruct drivers to do?
reference_answer: Slow down, keep left, and beware of oncoming traffic.
context:
[Document 1]
It indicates that a motorist can drive on ahead.

[Document 2]
It indicates the centre line of a two-way road.

[Document 3]
The road code conduct includes the two-second rule and stopping distance to ensure safe following distance while driving.

[Document 4]
Merging arrows indicate that two traffic lanes are merging into one traffic lane and give motorists advance warning of this situation.

[Document 5]
It indicates that vehicles can proceed straight ahead as well as make a right turn.
answer: The 'Two-way traffic ahead' sign instructs drivers to use both lanes and can proceed straight ahead or make a right turn [Document 5].
